architecture_basis: torchvision MobileNetV2 standard width-1 stages, independently checked against torchvision 0.25.0
initialization: Conv Kaiming normal fan_out; BN gamma=1 beta=0; Linear normal std=0.01 bias=0
weight_policy: Original vendored Any-Precision tanh/E quantizer; its W32 path is not identity. Stem Conv2d and classifier Linear weights remain ordinary FP32.
activation_policy: Internal nonlinear sites use released Any-Precision ReLU at A32; low-bit sites clamp to [0,1] then round with identity STE.
fp32_activation_exceptions: Raw normalized input and stem ReLU
Linear projection BatchNorm outputs and residual additions, hence inputs to the next expansion can be floating point
Global pooling, dropout, classifier, softmax and losses
activation_label_scope: A bit labels identify placed quantizers; not every tensor or convolution input is quantized.
update: One native minibatch, five forward/backward passes, sum gradients, exactly one Adam update. No microbatch emulation.
distillation: Highest precision uses hard CE. Each lower precision uses detached soft targets from the immediately previous precision.
bn_policy: One independent bank per precision at every BN site, including stem. Evaluation updates no banks.
reconstruction_choices_not_confirmed_by_: Width multiplier 1 and standard stage layout
Precise placement of Any-Precision operators inside MobileNetV2
Unquantized stem activation and preservation of linear bottleneck outputs
